item.title: ‘Country’ Joe McDonald, ’60s rock star, proud protest counterculture icon, dies at 84
item.description: By HILLEL ITALIE NEW YORK (AP) — “Country” Joe McDonald, a hippie rock star of the 1960s whose “I-Feel-Like-I’m-Fixin’-To-Die Rag” was a four-lettered rebuke to the Vietnam War that became an anthem for protesters and a highlight of the Woodstock music festival, died Sunday.
